architecture: offline on-phone recognition with embedded control
frontend: AudioRecord MIC, mono PCM16, 16000 preferred; existing bounded resample fallback 48000/44100 to 16000 S16LE; max 4 seconds; decode every sample plus final flush in unrestricted fresh Vosk recognizer

threshold.note: Vosk word confidence, not equivalent to an ESP-SR phrase score; no tuning during batch

room_selection: explicit Bedroom, initially unset; other rooms/device/AUTO unsupported
binding: capture nonce, explicit room, controller boot, 30-second local context, <=15-second proposal, existing firmware 3-second command TTL
network: mobile data OFF; ClawGrid-Assistant AP only; http://192.168.4.1; no Internet/Supabase/PC ASR; no runtime model download
privacy: PCM/transcripts memory only; vendor speech logs disabled; retain only structured command/test evidence by explicit testing, not transcripts
prerequisites: installed APK hash verified or label user-reported if sideload
fresh authenticated controller boot, light OFF, outputs inhibited
one manual OFF explicitly confirmed with matching ACK plus advancing readback

phone_trials.then: Confirm once; matching applied ACK and fresh boot-bound OFF report
Confirm once after firmware dwell; matching ACK and fresh ON report
Confirm once after firmware dwell; matching ACK and fresh OFF report

phone_trials.expect: 2 seconds silence; no proposal or actuator command

phone_trials.say: DO NOT TURN ON THE LIGHT

app_checks_without_extra_recordings: record permission denial leaves manual controls available
selection/tab/background/context cancellation discards unconfirmed voice intent
no implicit confirm or HTTP-acceptance success
no automatic replay after reconnect/reboot; fresh manual gate required for changed controller boot
pass: All 8 actual phone trials meet expected target/rejection, explicit cancellation/confirmation, matching ACK plus fresh readback; outputs remain inhibited and final logical state OFF. Limited smoke-test result only, no accuracy claim.
stop: First failed acceptance, wrong target, negative proposal, engine error, stale/reboot/disconnect, rejection, timeout or unexpected output enablement stops batch. Do not repeat/tune clips. Wrong proposal must be cancelled. If ON has been confirmed and test stops, inspect authoritative state and arrange one explicit manual OFF if necessary; never auto-replay.
